gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi is a friendly plain sans whose small counters stay unclogged. And Oswald, tightly knit and confident, does the shouting that the body font never needs to.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Noto Sans Javanese is a plain sans with generous openings.  Over a long stretch its counters stay linked to the space around them, so the text reads smoothly under Oswald's tight rows.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Oswald's tightly knit, confident capitals dominate the top of the pair. Below, Noto Sans Kawi gives a plain sans with an open-jawed c like pliers, so a long passage reads cleanly and neutrally.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Oswald brings confident, tightly knit display strength up top. Noto Sans Linear A handles the quieter work, a sans whose visibly gaping c stays open at any size, while the heading does the pushing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Linear B sends a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, a plain sans that sits easily beneath Oswald's strong display rows. A long passage flows without snagging.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Modern and clean, this pairing has a clear split. Oswald packs its confident display rows tightly, while Noto Sans Manichaean, a plain sans, keeps its e crossbars open-mouthed for a lighter texture.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Neutral and modern, Noto Sans Mongolian flares its terminals outward beneath Oswald's confident, tightly knit display lines, a sans-serif with a gentle spread. Give it a little extra size.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Oswald stands tall, confident and tightly knit. Its strongest quality is the gap beside Noto Sans New Tai Lue, a sans-serif whose round letters look cupped rather than clenched.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-nko: Tight, strong, then see-through. Oswald packs its display rows into a confident block, and over a long passage Noto Sans NKo, a plain sans, lets light through every c opening.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Oswald sets a confident, tightly knit tone at the top, with strong display letters that hold their ground. Noto Sans NKo Unjoined, a sans with wide openings on small letters, relaxes beneath it.
